connection_type.title: Intellipool – connection type
connection_type.description:
Choose how to connect.

• Cloud (intellipool.eu) – the most values, recommended for the INTP-1010B
• Official API (domotique-piscine.eu) – fewer values but very reliable
• Local – only for devices that run their own web server (not the INTP-1010B)

scan.title: Network scan
scan.description: Found {count} candidate device(s) on the network. Pick your Intellipool or enter the IP address manually.

local.title: Local connection
local.description: Enter the IP address of your controller. The integration probes common API endpoints automatically.

cloud.title: Cloud connection (intellipool.eu)
cloud.description: Use your intellipool.eu credentials. The official-API fields are optional and enable the failsafe: if the cloud scrape stops updating, data is fetched from the official API instead.

official.title: Official API (domotique-piscine.eu)
official.description: Enter the installation ID and API key. Both appear in your REST URL, in the form /api/install/INSTALLATION-ID/probe/water-temp?key=API-KEY

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and your network.
error.endpoint_not_found: No local API found on that device. See the README for protocol discovery.
error.no_serial: Login succeeded but the pool serial could not be detected automatically. Enter it manually (the number in displaySummary('...') on intellipool.eu).
error.bad_failsafe: Failsafe: the API key or installation ID is wrong. Leave both blank if you don't want a failsafe.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

data.stale_minutes: Failsafe: switch to the official API after (minutes without an update)

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Backfills Home Assistant long-term statistics with hourly historic values from intellipool.eu (water/air temperature, pH, ORP, salinity, pump power and speed, sensor battery, radio signal). Requires the cloud connection.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back to import.
